delivery.checkFirst: Check the target terminal first. This task will not be pasted again automatically.

delivery.confirmBody: Confirm only if this instruction appears in the target terminal. Submission does not mean the task is complete; the agent must still report its result.
delivery.abandonBody: This task will not be delivered again. This does not prove it was never written to the terminal. Check whether the target has already started work.
delivery.changed: The state may have changed. Review the refreshed task before deciding.
